{{Quote|Patch 4, dead ahead!"<br />"I know, I can smell it already!|Luke Skywalker and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Star Wars 59" />}}
'''Patch-4''' was a trash-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that was used to store valuable merchandise by [[Orion Ferret]], an infamous weapons dealer and owner of the ''[[Bazarre]]'' [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Patch-4 became the unlikely home of a tight-knit group of refugees cast out of their previous homes by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, this small population was threatened by [[Ceasar]], the massive and deadly [[watchbeast]] Ferret used to guard his wares.

==Description==
{{Quote|Now, Lando, you know there has to be some place where people can dump unrecyclable machine parts."<br />"I know, and machines don't bother me. It's the coffee grounds and bantha tripe I can't take!|Luke Skywalker and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Star Wars 59" />}}
A [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Patch system/Legends|Patch system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Patch-4 was covered in refuse and garbage, producing a very pungent stench that blanketed the entire planet and resulted in a runny, jelly-like surface. The planet's garbage formed into peaks and valleys, and avalanches of trash could be dangerous to beings on the surface. Much of the trash discarded on Patch-4 was machine parts and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] remains, which stuck out as landmarks from the morass on the surface. Despite its unsanitary situation, however, Patch-4 could support a population of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], a group of so-called "hoboes" carved out a living space in tunnels beneath the surface, constructing underground living quarters and managing to subsist for a long period of time.<ref name="Star Wars 59" />

==History==
{{Quote|In time, we all come here, make friends, decide to stay. And is good home. Little smelly, but is not bad&mdash;until crumb-bum Ferret show up!|Serja Kesselrook|<ref name="Star Wars 59" />}}
[[File:Ceasar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ceasar emerges to attack from beneath Patch-4's surface.]]
By the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Patch-4 became home to a small, tight-knit community of refugees cast out of their homes by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;these so-called "hoboes" had found their way to Patch-4 after spending time hopping [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and traveling rough across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, their community came under threat sometime around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when weapons dealer [[Orion Ferret]], owner of the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] called ''[[Bazarre]]'', began to make use of Patch-4 to store some of his more valuable wares. To this end he introduced a massive [[watchbeast]] called [[Ceasar]] to defend his possessions, and the deadly worm-like creature began to terrorize the local population and drive them to take refuge underneath the trash-covered surface.<ref name="Star Wars 59" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited Patch-4 after brokering a deal for four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] with Ferret, who had kept the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] concealed amidst the planet's junk. However, Ferret planned to leave the Rebels to Ceasar's mercy, then keep the valuable merchandise for himself once they were [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Calrissian and Skywalker enlisted the aid of the "hoboes" and managed to tame Ceasar with a [[sonic pacifier]], allowing them to secure their starfighters and giving the vagabonds their new home back.<ref name="Star Wars 59" />

==Behind the scenes==
Patch-4 appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 59|''Star Wars'' 59]], written by [[David Michelinie]], illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="Star Wars 59" />
